identity.name: Variational Omni SK Hynix Inc. Perp

about.description: SKHY is a single-stock perpetual on Variational tracking SK Hynix Inc. SK Hynix Inc. is a South Korean semiconductor company and one of the world's largest memory chip manufacturers, listed on the Korea Exchange (KRX: 000660). The market is cash-settled with hourly funding, no shareholder rights, and no dividend rights in the underlying.
